Omnibus Repeal Day (Spring 2014) Bill 2014

Criticised the day's repeal bills for delivering only $1.8 million in savings while $5.1 million in new compliance costs had been added for motorists the same week, and cited the abolition of the Fishing Industry Policy Council, established in 1991 but which had never met, as an example of the bill's low-value measures.
